title: Scan Session Manifest
description: Written alongside TIFF files when a scan session closes. Provides a complete record of the session for downstream classification, OCR, and book reconstruction pipelines.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Consumers must check this before parsing.

session_id.description: Unique session identifier in format YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS-hexrand. Matches the session directory name.

timestamp_start.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the first page scan in this session.

timestamp_end.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of session close (last page scanned + idle timeout, or manual close).

source_device.description: Device identifier matching the NFD label value (e.g. 'epson-ds-1630').

input_method.description: Which physical input was used. ADF sessions close when the feeder empties; flatbed sessions close on idle timeout or manual action.

duplex.description: Whether duplex scanning was enabled. Only meaningful for ADF sessions; always false for flatbed.

resolution_dpi.description: Scan resolution in dots per inch. Default capture resolution is 600.

color_mode.description: SANE color mode. Default capture mode is 'color' (24-bit). Grayscale and lineart included for future flexibility but not used in Phase 1.

page_count.description: Total number of page images in this session. For duplex ADF scans, each physical sheet produces two pages (front + back).

pages.description: Ordered list of scanned page images.

filename.description: Filename within the session directory. Zero-padded three-digit sequence.

side.description: Which side of the physical sheet. 'single' for flatbed scans and simplex ADF.

output_path.description: Absolute path on the NAS to the session directory containing the TIFFs and this manifest.

user_tags.description: Optional user-applied tags from the web UI. Free-form strings for downstream routing hints.

notes.description: Optional free-text notes from the web UI. Passed through to downstream pipelines.
